content: अनुविधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To lay down a rule, regulate. .²2 To obey, act up to, follow, conform to; see अनुविधायिन्; पदमनुविधेयं च महताम् <ls>Bh. 2. 28</ls> the foot-steps of the great have to be trodden in. .²3 To resemble, imitate. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} To be trained to follow rules; obey.
